response.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS z, s.entrystat AS st, sm.facetfaces AS f FROM scanmesh sm JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref), site AS (SELECT z, st, AVG(f) AS a FROM m GROUP BY z, st HAVING AVG(f) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(f) AS ov FROM m), stat AS (SELECT st, AVG(a) AS sa FROM site WHERE st IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st) SELECT AVG(site.a) AS avg_faces, AVG(site.a - overall.ov) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(site.a - stat.sa) AS avg_above_status FROM site JOIN stat ON stat.st = site.st CROSS JOIN overall WHERE site.a > stat.sa AND overall.ov IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the pooled average of facetfaces over all matched mesh records (sites with and without an access status), not the average of site averages.
Sites whose mesh records all have NULL facetfaces have no site average and are dropped. Sites with a NULL entrystat are excluded from the status comparison but still count toward the overall average.
If the overall average is NULL, no sites count and the single row returns NULLs.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the simple average of all matched sites' averages (including sites without an access status), rather than the pooled record-level average.
